title: Rule255 gate address-policy divergence: Python accepts loopback IPv4-mapped bad-scope-multicast, Rust fatals same bytes
description: Confirmed empirically by 3x codereview (discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-xuc8). Python validate_full_ipv6 -> _validate_ipv6_addresses (python/src/lichen/schc/headers.py:83-87) rejects only unspecified/multicast source and unspecified destination; Rule 255 encode (headers.py:145,816) and decode (headers.py:168) accept loopback endpoints, IPv4-mapped endpoints, and multicast destinations of ANY scope. Rust validate_address_policy (rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs:241-263, called from validate_full_ipv6:279 gating compress:2140, encode_rule255:1414, decode_rule255:1444) additionally rejects loopback, IPv4-mapped, and multicast scope outside 2..=14. Trigger bytes (port 10883, valid checksum, TC=FL=0 or TC=0x10): src=::1, src=::ffff:192.0.2.1, dst=::1, dst=ff01::1 (scope 1), dst=ff0f::1 (scope 15): Python emits byte-preserving Rule255 and round-trips; Rust returns Err(InvalidPacket) on compress AND on decompress of the Python-emitted bytes — identical on-air bytes decode in one implementation and not the other (hard interop break; also inflates RuleVersionFailureTracker misbehaving-peer notifications via decompress_authenticated_frame_tracked codec.rs:1470-1482). Spec is ambiguous: spec/03-adaptation.md:170-177 scopes address policy to Rule 7 selection, :183-186 mandates Rule255 fallback for packets failing only a matching requirement, :415-417 defines Rule255 payload validity without address policy (favors Python), but :177 invalidates interface-local scope 1 on a transmitted link (favors Rust). Fix needs a spec-level canonicalization of validate_full_ipv6 endpoint policy, aligned in both implementations, plus shared fallback vectors for loopback/IPv4-mapped/scope-0-1-15 endpoints. Distinct from project-LICHEN-worker6-prld (which covers Rule255 accepting structurally malformed data; this is opposite-verdict divergence on structurally valid data).
close_reason: Closed: last child 1jbb complete. Final state of the k0r2 divergence: the 5 trigger classes (loopback src, IPv4-mapped src, loopback dst, scope-1 dst, scope-15 dst) are pinned by shared corpus rows with encode-REJECT + byte-preserving-decode-ACCEPT asserted in BOTH implementations (rust RX split landed faed8ccfb5/wlts; python emission enforcement landed 8b07985284); python rule7 message texts canonicalized ef4eb8de22 (767->769 tests green fleet-side); rust test compile fixed same commit. Remaining endpoint-policy work tracked by: 29bu (P1: python RX still applies _validate_ipv6_addresses on the 3 unspecified/multicast-source classes - spec 03 TX/RX split violation found by probe during this round, independently corroborated by reviewer-model security pass; adds the 3 remaining corpus rows when fixed) and wrxl (P1: C compress gate lacks the emission policy entirely). Corpus now 10 rows in schc_adaptation.json; python 769/769; rust adaptation_vectors 2/2 + shared_vectors 3/3; C parity 48 PASS.
